title: Rich operator messages: formatted tells + attachments
description:
Rough scope (flesh out when fronted): teach the operator channel the rich message elements the transport already supports — demoed live 2026-08-16 via raw Bot API, chosen by the operator over the channel itself (multi-select answer: formatted-tells + attachments).

Deliverables sketch:
- Channel interface: additive methods for formatted text and attachments (SendFormatted or a message struct with markup flag; SendAttachment for documents/photos with optional caption + gate buttons). Telegram impl (HTML parse mode, sendDocument/sendPhoto), FakeChannel, fakebot coverage.
- CLI: tk tell --format (or auto-detected markdown subset) and tk tell --file <path>; tk ask photo+gate shape for content review.
- Keep Send plain-text contract intact (review decision, epic 54v); formatting is a new path, never re-interpretation of existing text.
- Interlocks with epic 7ab (tick attachments / screenshots for content review): 7ab produces the screenshots, this epic delivers them to the phone with approve/reject under the standard gate provenance rules.
- Channel-neutral: every element must be expressible in Slack Block Kit terms before it lands in the interface.
